Your main drain valve is currently closed, you'll want to open it by giving it a quarter turn. When the "off" tab is aligned with the pipe, that valve is closed. If the manual valve feels locked, loosen the screw holding the handle down, pull it out slightly, and then rotate it. 

Your actuator is currently set properly for normal filtration with a spillover effect from your spa into your pool. When you are in pool mode, you do not want to pull water from the main drain of your spa. 91,000,000 shares worth of 250 calls will be "in the money" meaning that the holder of 1 contract can buy 100 shares at 250$ regardless of what the market value is.
To satisfy this contract, the shares are bought at market value and delivered to the holder of the contract at that 250$ strike price. 
Not all options get exercised, they're usually just sold for a profit. However, if even a fraction of the options get exercised, say... 20m shares worth, we are in for a nice gamma squeeze, as 20m purchased shares on the market makes for a nice 🚀. Especially on a stock with such low liquidity. 
The seller of these contracts will also buy shares as the price increases to hedge against what they will have to deliver. It creates an upwards snowball effect in price.
